name: r111_front
notes: The R-111's front (tools/blender/r111_trace.py). Main photo: r111_photos, valka.cz topic 38123 attachment 1746955541_1.JPG (1824 x 1368 px, nearly square-on; not kept). Second reference: r111_to fig. 4 (tools/traces/r111_drawing.json). Scale: the plate 600 mm wide, scaled from csla_pu12_manual's plan where the R-123M on the set reads at its true 481 mm (about 5 %); the height from the flattened photo. The lower strip (the connectors) lies in a recess (r111_to p. 60: the panel's lower, recessed part): its edges are not in the upper plate's plane and are not used to flatten.
